name: quota-nexus
displayName: Quota Nexus - AI Usage & Context Monitor
description: Unofficial AI usage monitor for Antigravity, Claude Code and Codex: quota, rate limits, token usage, reset times and context window in your status bar. Alerts, forecasts and history. Local-first, stores no sign-in tokens.

commands.title: Sign In With Another Antigravity Account

quotaNexus.statusBar.show.description: Show quota in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Antigravity: Gemini 0% · Claude / GPT-OSS 78% used | Claude Code: 3% · wk 76% used | Codex: 34% used
quotaNexus.statusBar.format.description: Label style for the status bar. Compact and minimal mark each number with ↑ (used) or ↓ (left).

enumDescriptions: Show what is used, counting up to 100%, like the Claude Code and Codex screens (for example 57% used)
Show what is left, counting down to 0% (for example 43% left)
quotaNexus.display.percentMode.description: Show quota as percent left or percent used, in the status bar, hover and dashboard. Alerts and colours always work on what is left.

quotaNexus.statusBar.showEmail.description: Show the signed-in Antigravity account in the status bar. Off by default for screen sharing.

quotaNexus.refresh.pauseWhenUnfocused.description: Pause polling while the window is not focused. Refreshes as soon as you return.

quotaNexus.alerts.enabled.description: Notify when a quota or limit runs low (Antigravity, Claude Code and Codex).

quotaNexus.alerts.thresholds.description: Percent-left levels that trigger a notification. The highest also turns the status bar yellow, the lowest red.

quotaNexus.alerts.notifyOnReset.description: Notify when a used quota is full again.

enumDescriptions: Show every session used in the last 15 minutes (or the newest one)
Show every tracked session side by side
quotaNexus.contextWindow.display.description: Which context window to show in the status bar.

quotaNexus.contextWindow.showAntigravity.description: Track the context window of the active Antigravity conversation.

quotaNexus.claudeCode.enable.description: Track Claude Code sessions from the local logs in ~/.claude/projects.

quotaNexus.claudeCode.showContextWindow.description: Include the Claude Code context window in the status bar.

quotaNexus.claudeCode.fetchUsageLimits.markdownDescription: Show Claude Code 5-hour and weekly limits. **Opt-in:** reads your existing Claude Code token from `~/.claude/.credentials.json` and sends it only to `api.anthropic.com`, at most every 5 minutes. Never refreshes or rewrites the token. Uses an undocumented endpoint that may change.

quotaNexus.claudeCode.showInNavBar.description: Include Claude Code limits in the status bar (needs Fetch Usage Limits).

quotaNexus.codex.enable.description: Track Codex sessions and rate limits from the local logs in ~/.codex/sessions. No network, no token.

quotaNexus.codex.showInNavBar.description: Include Codex rate limits in the status bar.

quotaNexus.codex.showContextWindow.description: Include the Codex context window in the status bar.
